title: imap/auth: username comparison is not constant-time, leaks existence
description: verify_credentials() in crates/imap/src/session/auth.rs:44 uses iter().any(|cred| cred.username == username && cred.password.ct_eq(...)) — the && short-circuits, so the bcrypt-equivalent constant-time password check only runs when a matching username is found. A non-matching username exits immediately via fast string comparison. An attacker can enumerate valid IMAP usernames by measuring response latency. Fix: always run ct_eq on both username and password against all entries (or always compare against a dummy credential for missing users, similar to reader's dummy_hash approach).
